bpmn:participant.name: BPMN-19 | Third-Party Courier Booking and Booking Recovery

bpmn:process.name: Third-Party Courier Booking and Booking Recovery
bpmn:process.bpmn:documentation: Sources: docs/proposed-bpmn-catalog.md BPMN-19 and full catalog boundaries; Chapters/Kitchen406 - Capstone Paper.md SRS 4.16 FR-DEL-01,08-11,14,17; FR-FUL-18-20; supporting FR-FUL-23,26, NFR-SEC-14, NFR-REL-01-05 and BR-26-27,34. Implementation: index.html loads app/delivery-state.js V.reason/book/refresh, app/delivery-tracking.js T.book, app/owner-orders.js, app/earnings-allocation.js and app/subscription-batches.js. Existing BPMN-15/16/17/18 reviewed for detail and reuse; SRS governs differences: FR-DEL-10 restricts booking initiation to Admin/Owner though the in-memory prototype permits Staff; provider outcomes are simulated in the prototype, and its booked state must not be taken as proof a rider is already assigned. Scope is a standard order or weekly subscription fulfillment using courier delivery. New booking requires paid Ready state; existing-attempt reconciliation does not require new-booking eligibility. Authorized Admin/Owner page access is an entry precondition handled upstream by BPMN-30 and protected-page routing (FR-DEL-10; NFR-SEC-03,14). No repeated access task or authorization gateway is modeled here. Courier scope, existing booking state and new-booking prerequisites have separate visible gateways. Automatic server-side authorization remains required on protected reads and booking/recovery actions. Cake handoff belongs to BPMN-21 and pickup to BPMN-18. Authentication is a BPMN-30 precondition; enforce owner-only operational authorization before accessing/acting on a booking. Internal Owner/System lanes share sequence flows; the separate black-box Lalamove participant uses message flows for supported booking and reconciliation exchanges. No generic broadcast/signal event is introduced. All local checks and failure/recovery outcomes are visible. User-directed workflow update: Owner allocation review/validation takes place when Mark as Ready is requested in the preparation workflow. Courier booking reads those saved Ready-stage allocations and does not invoke BPMN-16, reopen the allocation editor, or accept a combined allocation draft. Automatic permission, current-version, paid Ready-state and booking-lock safeguards still apply at the protected booking claim. Missing or changed Ready-stage allocation context blocks booking for operational review; it is not corrected by this process. Other BPMNs and the SRS are not revised by this scoped change. No checkout address/quotation repetition, weekly payment, automated refund, automatic retry loop, booking cancellation request, rider tracking or delivery completion is invented. Initial checkout eligibility/fees are BPMN-02/22; subsequent tracking/completion and failed/cancelled status updates are BPMN-20. One booking attempt/fulfillment is saved consistently before provider submission, with allocation lock; status/identity survive ambiguous provider or persistence failures. Never release a possibly active booking merely because the response is lost. Supported batch booking operates independently per fulfillment. Existing BPMNs are unchanged.

bpmn:startEvent.name: Authorized Owner requests booking or recovery review

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Load selected fulfillment and booking history
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: After Owner authorization, retrieve the selected fulfillment and booking attempts, saved order type/method, payment and operational state, destination, Ready-stage allocations, version and operation/provider identities. Missing or unavailable target is returned explicitly, never fabricated as an empty new booking history. No provider booking or allocation change occurs.

bpmn:businessRuleTask.name: Check fulfillment type and courier-delivery method
bpmn:businessRuleTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-DEL-01,14,16. Establish whether the selected record is a standard order or individual subscription fulfillment using courier delivery. Do not apply paid Ready or new-destination prerequisites here: an existing pending/unresolved attempt must remain available for reconciliation even if operational status changed. Cakes and pickup use separate processes.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: Standard order or subscription with courier delivery?

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Explain unpaid, not-Ready or incomplete saved delivery details
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Explain the specific new-booking blocker and retain all saved records, booking history and locks. No new booking, payment, address replacement or automatic fulfillment-method change. Correct operational details through their owning workflow before a fresh booking review.

bpmn:endEvent.name: New booking blocked; review fulfillment details
Existing active booking retained — BPMN-20
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: Booked/in-transit or other established active booking is not submitted again. Retain allocation lock. Existing tracking and completion belong to BPMN-20. Delivered/completed records cannot become new bookings through this process.

bpmn:userTask.name: Review saved delivery details and request a new booking
bpmn:userTask.bpmn:documentation: Only no prior attempt or definitively failed/cancelled prior booking may proceed, while fulfillment remains incomplete and otherwise eligible. Review saved checkout destination and delivery data. Subscription address remains agreed for all four fulfillments; actual fee differences are borne by bakery under BR-27. No new customer charge/refund. Owner allocations were reviewed/validated when Mark as Ready was requested. Reuse those saved allocations without another allocation prompt or BPMN-16 call. Booking review concerns saved delivery details and consent to booking, not owner selection.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Request cancelled; saved state retained
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: Cancelling the local confirmation creates no courier booking and changes no allocation/lock. This is not a provider cancellation API operation.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Recheck controls; atomically claim new attempt and save pending lock
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-DEL-17; FR-FUL-18-20; NFR-SEC-14, NFR-REL-03,05. Atomically recheck owner permission, version, paid Ready state, the saved allocations from the successful Ready transition still belonging to the current fulfillment/version, stored destination and absence of another pending/active/unresolved attempt. Persist one attempt identity, saved request context, prior-attempt link/history and pending lock/timestamp before calling provider. Failed local commit sends nothing and preserves prior state. Create and claim a new attempt for this request only if no pending/active/unresolved attempt exists. The claim and pending allocation lock save together under serialized/version-checked control. If a concurrent matching request already created an attempt, return its current saved state without acquiring submission ownership: pending/unresolved routes to reconciliation, established active routes to tracking. A reused record never grants permission to submit. A definitively failed/cancelled attempt discovered after review, or conflicting/stale state, requires fresh review rather than automatic creation. Never transfer a possibly used claim or retry external submission after an ambiguous outcome. Use and lock the saved Ready-stage allocations without editing or re-running their selection/percentage-validation workflow. If their Ready-stage context is missing or changed, reject this booking claim for operational review; do not silently create allocations or reopen the allocation editor.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: Atomic attempt-claim result?
bpmn:exclusiveGateway.bpmn:documentation: Only a newly created attempt claimed by this request authorizes provider submission. Reused pending/unresolved and established active attempts take separate non-creation paths. Conflict/save failure sends nothing. Reconciliation is read-only with respect to booking creation, even while the original claimant may still be running.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Explain conflict/save failure; do not contact provider
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: No request is sent without a saved consistent attempt/lock. Preserve independently committed newer booking state. Review and refresh before another authorized request; no blind provider retry.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Submit newly claimed attempt once to Lalamove; resolve response
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-DEL-11. This activity is reachable only by the request that atomically created and claimed the new attempt. Use its saved order/destination information and attempt identity; dispatch once for that claim. A reused, pending, unresolved or already submitted attempt cannot enter this creation activity. If execution stops or the submission result is ambiguous, retain the attempt and lock for reconciliation rather than reclaiming it for another submission. Preserve response/provider reference and diagnosis. Successful creation means a booking exists, not necessarily an assigned rider or completed delivery. Classify definitive failed/cancelled outcomes separately from timeout, lost response or ambiguous result. If provider may have accepted but persistence fails, keep unresolved attempt/lock for reconciliation, not a new creation. Do not assume a provider-specific idempotency capability absent from requirements.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Save established provider booking and retain allocation lock
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Save provider booking reference/status with attempt/history and current version consistently. Preserve agreed delivery data, original product amounts and confirmed subscription commitment. A failed local save after provider creation must retain unresolved pending state/lock; no new request is safe until reconciliation. Completion and completion timestamp are not recorded by booking.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Booking established; continue tracking in BPMN-20

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Save confirmed Failed/Cancelled; permit eligible review
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Only a definitive provider failure/cancellation permits this result. Preserve attempt/provider history. Release the booking-related allocation lock only if fulfillment is incomplete and no other pending/active/unresolved booking exists. Retain Ready state, paid purchase and delivery information. Allocation edit/rebooking are allowed only after normal eligibility checks. Do not cancel the paid fulfillment or refund automatically.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Definitive failure; owner may review and rebook

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Retain unresolved attempt and allocation lock; show recovery status
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Timeout/lost response, ambiguous provider outcome or persistence failure after possible provider acceptance: retain attempt identity, any reference/request evidence, saved pending state and allocation lock. Explain that another booking cannot be submitted. Safe recovery uses existing-attempt reconciliation, never blind creation or unlocking. Log diagnosis without exposing secrets.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Outcome unresolved; reconcile before any new booking

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Resolve existing attempt with Lalamove; do not create another
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: NFR-REL-01-03; FR-DEL-17. For pending/unresolved saved attempt, use preserved identity/provider reference and supported provider status lookup to determine its outcome. Never submit a new booking as a status query. If lookup is unavailable or cannot establish an outcome, retain unresolved state/lock and require further reconciliation. No fabricated cancellation or provider behavior is assumed. If recovery establishes delivery progress, BPMN-20 processes tracking/completion.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Save recovered booking reference/status; retain lock
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Associate discovered booking with the original attempt, preserve saved identity/history and current version, and retain active/unresolved lock as applicable. Never create another booking. On save conflict/failure keep unresolved saved state and lock for further reconciliation; do not assert successful recovery.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Save definitive Failed/Cancelled; retain history
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Recovered provider evidence establishes the prior attempt failed/cancelled. Save consistently and allow review/edit/rebooking only while incomplete and without another pending/active/unresolved booking. If this save fails, keep prior unresolved state/lock; do not authorize new booking. Fresh booking requires owner confirmation and all new-attempt checks.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Prior failure resolved; owner may start fresh review
Still unresolved; keep lock and block new booking
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: Lookup or local save could not safely resolve the attempt. Preserve prior state, attempt evidence and lock. Safe reconciliation can be requested later. No automatic retry interval or maximum count is invented.

bpmn:sequenceFlow.name: New attempt claimed by this request

bpmn:textAnnotation.bpmn:text: Entry decisions Authorized Owner page access is required before entry (BPMN-30). Courier scope: standard order or one subscription fulfillment using delivery. Existing pending/unresolved attempt: reconcile without requiring new-booking eligibility. Established active booking: retain and track. Only a new booking requires paid Ready state and complete saved delivery details. No cakes, pickup or repeated checkout quotation.

Saved Ready-stage owner allocations Allocation review/validation occurs on Mark as Ready (preparation workflow). Booking reuses the saved allocations; no BPMN-16 call or allocation prompt. Automatically guard current permission, version, Ready state and booking locks. Missing/changed Ready-stage context blocks booking for review. Pending/active/unresolved booking locks allocations. Definitive failure/cancellation may permit review only while incomplete. Staff acting does not earn an owner allocation.

Safe provider submission Atomically save new attempt + submission claim + pending lock. Only the creating claimant submits once. Existing pending/unresolved: reconcile, never resubmit. Existing established booking: retain and track. Conflict/save failure: send nothing; preserve current state. Unknown result ≠ confirmed failure. Retain evidence and lock; reconcile the existing attempt before another booking. No blind creation retry after response loss.

Business boundaries An established booking does not mean Delivered or that a rider is already assigned. BPMN-20 owns tracking and completion. No live rider-location tracking. Subscription address remains agreed; bakery absorbs later actual-fee differences (BR-26/27). No new customer charge/refund. Failed/cancelled attempts require fresh owner review before rebooking.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Explain unsupported order type/method or unavailable target; retain state
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Standard orders and individual subscription fulfillments using courier delivery belong here. Cakes and pickup orders do not. Do not change fulfillment method, paid purchase, booking or lock state.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Courier workflow does not apply; no booking changes

bpmn:businessRuleTask.name: Check paid Ready state and complete saved delivery details
bpmn:businessRuleTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-DEL-08,10-11. This check applies only when no booking exists or the previous attempt definitively failed/cancelled. Require paid Ready fulfillment and complete saved order/destination data. Existing active and pending/unresolved attempts bypass this new-booking check. Use saved Ready-stage allocations without reopening allocation validation or owner selection. Preserve confirmed subscription addresses. Do not repeat Maps/fee checkout or payment.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: Paid, Ready and saved delivery details complete?
